8.6.11. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.PositiveEdges¶

class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.PositiveEdges(railyard, noPrefix=False, noSuffix=False, branch=True, posOrient=True)¶

Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for all positive paths in a railyard that starts from and ends in nodes whose degrees are not equal to 2.

Methods

__init__(railyard[, noPrefix, noSuffix, …]) Constructor.
generate() Iterator over the path-tuples of valid paths in railyard.
getPath() Return a path-tuple.
initPath() Initialize attributes startNodeIndex, endNodeIndex, edgeSequence and visited.
isBentLeg(processedNodeIndex) An utility function that determines if processedNodeIndex connects to a bent leg of a switch.
isEdge(processedNodeIndex, newNodeIndex) A callback function that determines if the edge from processedNodeIndex to newNodeIndex is a valid edge.
isEndNodeIndex() A callback function that determines if endNodeIndex is the end node index for a valid path.
isStartNodeIndex(startNodeIndex) A callback function that determines if startNodeIndex is the start node index for a valid path.
popPath() Pop the last edge from edgeSequence.
pushPath(endNodeIndex) Push the edge ending with endNodeIndex in edgeSequence if it is a valid edge (isEdge returns True).
